name: 361-root-dig
notes: B5.b (#361): before the first green, everyone gathers by digging roots in the dry stream bed. Style DigRoot (BerryMotion): kneel, paw (dust on every other down-stroke), the pull (lean 35 -> -15, big dust at the contact), the root held up 0.5 s, then it arcs into the basket (left hand). Two paw hits (small Dust) and one pull (big Dust) per 4 s. The arc is authored at this render's pull hit (hit at 1.7 s: t0 = hit + 0.56 s of held-up root). The 'root' object stands for the dug ground: it answers each hit (HitFx Dust, not drawn by the bench).
